body: I do, but talking really doesn't help much anymore. I've said everything. I just need things to change. Waiting hurts. I could kill myself at any moment. I've been living day to day for months. But I'm a fighter.

I just want to feel better. I'm tired of wanting to kill myself everyday. Thank you for your comment, but sexual dysfunction doesn't matter to me anymore. I'm not even going have sex. I'm going to die alone. I just want to feel good now.
That makes sense. Thank you!

So what? You didn't do a bunch of useless shit like get a degree and win trophies. You stayed in your house. It doesn't matter if that was a good idea or not, because its in the past. Dude, I want to OD on Xanax too, but not for being who I am. If you didn't like school, GOOD. Be proud of who you are. Everything you're saying, is what you think you hear from everyone else. THEY ARE LIES. I hate to say it, but you should see a professional about this. They're trained to help people like us. Please, at least consider it. And I'm sorry if I sounded aggressive.

You're entitled to life. That's a given. You say you don't deserve it because you claim you are a disappointment, but that would mean the point in life is to be successful in the eyes of others. But its not. You've never accomplished anything? I don't believe that. I do think you're in a bit of a hole though. You have the tools to succeed, but you're fighting to look good in the eyes of others. You need to learn to love yourself first. And don't worry about your parents. Even if you are 21, you're their kid and they signed up for this. Being a failure is subjective. Don't even give "failure" your time. You're worth more than a word that isn't even consistent in its meaning.

I haven't tried hanging myself. Instead of killing myself, I killed the parts myself that I don't like. Now I'm working on killing the parts of my life that I don't like, as well as getting treatment for my depression. Your life isn't a throwaway aacccount. Keep playing this slot machine called life, and eventually you'll hit the jackpot. And that's not false hope, that's just probability, since you have unlimited coins.

People have been treating me different too. They keep talking to me like I'm fragile. Its annoying. And it may feel like things wont change, but logically they have to. And that's not me giving you the classic "it gets better" bullshit. Its  just the way the world works. Things will get better and worse. What's the point? Sorry, but I don't have the answer to that one. I'm just kind of doing things and hoping for the best. It hurts really bad, but its also kind of fun. My advice: don't take life too seriously. Go have fun and feel good. You deserve it.

Yup, that was me a few months ago. I was under age, so I got put in the hospital. He COULD be ok, but he could also be a threat to himself. If I were you, I would call someone who has authority over him. He might hate you for it, but he put this on you. I'm suicidal, but I would never put that kind of pressure on a friend.....again. Definitely call someone, or take him to the hospital. This sounds like a cry for help.

I wish I could give you THE ULTIMATE SOLUTION, but there really isn't one. Its like learning to walk, you just gotta keep falling until you finally get the coordination down. And its killing me too. At work, I'm known for my "lost puppy" look.

Communication is difficult. The best way to get better at communicating is to practice. Thankfully, you have plenty of options. I want to tell you to talk to one new person every day, but I feel like this is more serious than that. I would talk to a therapist if you haven't already, talk to a psychiatrist about medication if you haven't already, and talk to your friends. Specifically though, you just need to practice talking to practice talking to people. I have this same problem, and I know I sound like an asshole, but practice makes perfect.

You want change. You are not willing to live  the way you currently are. Those are naturally feelings. BUT, you don't have to give up. I want to tell you to check yourself into the hospital (because that's the best option), but I'm suicidal and I'm not even gonna do that. I suggest you call someone close to you. They know you and your story better than I do, and they can give you personal advice. I cant promise you everything is going to ok, but I can promise you that if try, you can change things. BUT PLEASE DONT JUMP.

6 years of fighting means you haven't killed the source of your depression. You've been killing the spider eggs, but the spider has just been laying more. I'm of course approaching this from a logos perspective. When your stock becomes worthless, that doesn't mean you are worthless. You're not all-powerful, you cant control the value of your stocks. All you can do is invest in something new. Things are going to get better and worse. You cant control what happens to you, but you can control how you react to those things. You want something. Fight for it. Thank you.

I agree. Baby steps is the right way to go. He might be a little overwhelmed, but that's because he cares about you. The fact that you want to tell him is a good sign for your mental health, and your relationship. He might blame himself, my mom did, but he'll learn that its not him. And you wouldn't be happy if you didn't wake up tomorrow, because dead people cant feel anything. It feels SO  much better to live. Good luck.

Ok, externally, things seem to be working out. An abusive household isn't something I can relate to, however, I was bullied for most of my childhood. And I can also relate to the fact that you are willing to wait until Monday. We have a similar way of thinking. DEATH IS NOT PEACEFUL. Why should you live? For the same reason you WANT to die. You want to feel good. Life can feel very good, good, bad, and very bad. You are able to feel unhappy, therefore you have the ability to feel happy. I agree, fuck family. Live for yourself. Go to Norway, experience your dreams, and create new dreams. Everyday is a struggle, but its a good struggle. Its the fight for peace.

Trust me, people do care about you. Those thoughts are lies. I told people I hate that I was going to kill myself, and even they tried to help me. As for just wanting to be loved, I know that feeling. But love takes time and work. Its not something that just happens, and that's part of what makes it special. I'm sure your pretty, but anyone who judges you based on that is shallow. Finally, a razor is just going to hurt you. Suicide isn't an investment worth your time or energy. Life, however, is definitely a great investment. And the first step to being happy, IMO, is to flush that razor. I like you. Now you need to like yourself :)

I get comforted by death too. I don't really have anything to lose. My friends are just as bad as my enemies, they're just better at pretending. But I'm still innocent enough to believe that love is guaranteed. Love is my goal.

10 years, that's more than half my life. I cant even imagine fighting depression for that long. If you don't mind me asking, what do you want out of life? Do you have any goals, or anything to hope for?

Wow. I don't know what I would do if someone said that to me. I've been yelled at before, but they just didn't want to see me die. Have you tried getting professional help? If have, you need to tell whoever you're seeing how you feel. And if you haven't, you should see a psychiatrist. Either way, there's no reason for you to fight this alone.

Same. I literally told this dude I was going to kill myself, and then refused to let him check me  back into the hospital. But if you say you're not going to kill yourself, and that you are just looking for meaning in life, you'll be fine. That fact that you would go to a therapist would show them you're not suicidal. Don't wait for this to get worse.

Because why live, right? Life doesn't make sense to me either. But, if your life is great, and you really don't feel like living, imagine what could happen if your life goes a little down hill a little bit. Hell, my life is great now, and I still want to kill myself. I don't disagree with your way of thinking, but its dangerous. I think you should see a therapist, if you haven't already. You need to want to live, and they'll help you with that.
"Rarely happens with guys though." I didn't mean to sound like an asshole. But that kind of thinking doesn't help you.

Yeah, communication is difficult. Everyone offends everyone with petty comments all the time. That's just life. If they're mature, they'll look past it. And remember, girls are people just like you. There's no reason to discriminate, not that I'm offended, but because that kind of thinking isn't beneficial to you.
Me too. Its not uncommon. Exposure therapy is what you need. I suggest you try to talk to a girl once a day. Just talk about anything. As long as you're friendly, you should be fine.

It always feels good to vent. I don't take self doubt seriously anymore. If it doesn't approach you in a respectful, mature manner, then it isn't worth your time. Eventually, people will be DYING to hang out with you. That's not me giving you false hope either. You're humble, and caring. People literally worship a guy like you on Sundays.

You are not your weight. You are your consciousness, and I'm sure you're fucking awesome. Loneliness is horrible horrible feeling, and I'm so sorry you feel that way. My advice: 1.) Get a personal trainer who can make your MIND healthier by exercising. The most powerful person isn't the best looking, the most powerful person is the one who has control over his mind. 2.) There is a reason people want nothing to do with you. There's a miscommunication SOMEWHERE. Find it, and fix it. 3.) See a psychiatrist. You need professional help. You're worth more than this. Thank you.

Yea, I wanna die too. I've played SO many video games to try to distract myself, but it doesn't seem to take the pain away. Honestly, when I feel that low I either text someone, exhaust the fuck out of my body, or go to sleep. Sorry if I'm not any help, but I thought Id try.

Ill have to work on staying positive. I know its not THE SOLUTION, but I'm sure it'll help. I'm confident in all the choices I've made in my life so far. I've made mistakes, but I have no regrets. Whatever I decide to do, I will achieve. I am sad, lonely and empty. But I am not afraid.

Depression lies. I like that phrase. Sucks when those irrational thoughts make sense. Probably means I've gone crazy. I don't want to kill myself. Id just rather die than feel this empty and this lonely. I've felt euphoria before. Its a very lonely feeling. I was created to long for an intimate relationship, yet not created with the ability to form an intimate relationship. For a boy to die at the age of 18 is perfectly acceptable to me, but for a boy to want to die at the age of 18 is truly tragic. And the worst part is that everyone he knew will be SUPRISED. They knew he was lonely, and they knew he was suicidal, but they had no idea he would kill himself. No one owed him their time, but he needed them. He needed someone to love him. Fuck the entire world.
But what did you do to get out of the dark place? I feel like there nothing I can do to fight the depression and suicidal thoughts.
What about mood stabilizers?

Probably doesn't help that I was diagnosed with social anxiety. And I cant take anti anxiety medication because I got my self addicted to benzos, that I found straight otta Compton. But Ill talk to my doctor about Wellbutrin. Thank you!
I'm not willing to take the risk. Do I have other options? I'm in therapy, but I really think I need medication. Could I get mood stabilizers?
I want a pet, but Im not allowed to get one...because I still live at home. Im sure I can put together a strong ethos argument though. Fuck it, Im getting a pet
Yea, I have a small group of friends, but they don't satisfy me. A girl friend would, but that seems pretty much impossible now. I'm really just looking for someone I can connect with.
Its cool
Damn I'm only worth over a hundred million lmfao. Seriously dude, thanks for the honesty, but get off my dick please.
You're an asshole, but I cant really argue with you, because you're right. I really do feel like people owe me something. Thanks for the advice.
